Recognize the approach

Swiss International typography developed a systematic approach to visual communication.

Look for

  • Consistent alignment and modular grids
  • Asymmetric sans-serif typography
  • Contrast through scale and spacing

Your learning goal

Describe the visual decisions before choosing a tool. Then make one small example that uses them deliberately.

Next: Origins

Where it comes from

Swiss International typography developed a systematic approach to visual communication. Grid relationships, photographic material, and clear information hierarchy are more useful lessons than copying one typeface.

What to examine

Look at the heading, one control, the image treatment, and the reading order. Explain which decisions establish the style and which make the page usable.

Next: Construction

How to construct it

  1. Define columns, gutters, and a type scale in CSS. Align captions and images to the same underlying edges.
  2. Use a few weights and inspect line breaks. Let empty space separate groups before adding borders.

Small practice task

Set a concert poster in two columns using only type, one photograph, and one accent. Explain every alignment.

Before you expand it

Test the result at its intended size, on a narrow screen, and with keyboard focus. Preserve editable layers and record the source and license of acquired assets.
